name: Carol Miller

on_the_ballot: Running, Republican for U.S. House (WV) - District 1

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by National Right to Life Committee

"As a mother & grandmother, I know the joys a child brings to a family. All life, no matter the age, should be cherished. I am pleased to see the Supreme Court overturn Roe v. Wade. An unborn child is a human life that must be protected. Today is a huge victory for all Americans."
"All children, no matter their age, should be cherished, and the Supreme Court’s decision overturning Roe v. Wade reaffirms that."
Voted in favor of HR 26: "Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act"
